product_one_liner.value: Rivo is an AI cash manager for households that moves idle cash from existing bank accounts into higher-yielding instruments and returns it before bills are due.
product_one_liner.notes: The FAQ identifies households as the audience; the company profile describes the AI layer; its investor describes automated transfers into higher-yielding instruments and back before bills. Sources: https://www.rivofi.com/faqs, https://linkedin.com/company/tryrivo and https://www.southparkcommons.com/companies/rivo.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link, and the pricing URL did not provide a pricing page. Fees are explained in FAQs and blog content instead. Homepage: https://www.rivofi.com/.

named_customers.notes: The homepage has anonymous customer testimonials but does not identify two customers. No qualifying named-customer page, case study or matching G2/Capterra listing was found; partners and investors were excluded. Closest source: https://www.rivofi.com/.

employee_band.notes: The public company profile reports seven employees, below every permitted band. No supported count fitting an allowed band was found, so this field is null rather than assigning 11–20: https://linkedin.com/company/tryrivo.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile places Rivo in San Francisco, corroborated by reporting describing it as San Francisco-based. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/tryrivo and https://www.thisweekinfintech.com/p/exclusive-from-self-driving-cars-to-self-driving-money-inside-rivo-s-bet-on-idle-cash. | hq_country: Rivo's company profile identifies its country as United States: https://linkedin.com/company/tryrivo.

founded_year.notes: Rivo's company profile explicitly lists 2025 as its founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/tryrivo.

eng_blog.notes: The rendered blog index contains company news, product explanations, comparisons and personal-finance articles, not two engineering-authored posts explaining how Rivo is built: https://www.rivofi.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: The homepage offers a single FAQ page, with no public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link. That meets the specified false condition: https://www.rivofi.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No accessible, complete current careers board for rivofi.com was found. The matching company listing explicitly says its job board is not tracked, so zero displayed roles cannot establish false. The Singapore AI-engineer posting belonged to another Rivo. Source: https://www.employbl.com/companies/rivo.

model_provider.notes: No AI model or provider was disclosed in the reviewed FAQ, product/blog pages, privacy policy or rendered subprocessor list. Krutrim and Microsoft are described as the CTO's former employers, not Rivo's providers. Sources: https://trust.rivofi.com/, https://www.rivofi.com/privacy-policy and https://www.rivofi.com/blog/funding-announcement.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Rivo explicitly claims SOC 2 compliance in its security FAQ. No other certification from the requested list was established: https://www.rivofi.com/faqs. | compliance_certs.0: The FAQ explicitly states SOC 2 compliance: https://www.rivofi.com/faqs.

raised_18mo.notes: The $2.7 million seed round announced in August 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260804547168/en/Rivo-Raises-%243.1M-to-Build-Self-Driving-Money-and-End-the-Inertia-Tax.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No complete accessible current job board for rivofi.com established whether SDR, BDR or account-executive positions are open. The matching listing says the company's board is not tracked, rather than confirming no openings: https://www.employbl.com/companies/rivo.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 4, 2026 announcement states that Rivo exited beta and opened to the public, within the requested six-month window: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260804547168/en/Rivo-Raises-%243.1M-to-Build-Self-Driving-Money-and-End-the-Inertia-Tax.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The CEO's documented start predates the window, but the CTO's joining date could not be established. crm_stack_signal.notes: No confirmed company job, documentation or integrations source established a CRM or sales/marketing system. A third-party job listing used a different company domain, so it was insufficient to assert either a named system or an empty list.
